sections.Profile:
The "Music Man" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in August 1960, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Singing, Original Theme, Festival, Marching Band, Instruments, Music
